<a id="summary"></a>

## Summary

Delivers req-15 and the rest of req-13 and req-27; builds c-skill and finishes c-templates. Depends on s03 (templates) and s09 (prompts). Wording is PEC (C26, C18): build what the work needs now, reshape as it changes; templates are examples. Workers are told what to do by their packets, not the route.

<a id="goals"></a>

## Goals

- Roadmap 001 s10: the pij skill gets a token-lean community route that teaches the prime to set up and run an emergent community (PEC), the PM to assign and release seats for its work, and the PA to see memory written before compacts; plus the optional role templates as examples.

<a id="non-goals"></a>

## Non-goals

- Anything another roadmap step owns; see roadmap 001.

<a id="execution-guardrails"></a>

## Execution Guardrails

- Tests use scratch repos and a private daemon; never the live governance branch or the prod daemon.
- Builds: your own target or `just shared-build`; CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0; -p scoping; stop under 25 GB free.
- No `git add -A`, no `--no-verify`; no node_modules, never symlinked (C25); TS proof is CI on the exact head.
- Shared seams (crates/cli wiring, skills/pij): rebase onto main before the PR and keep edits minimal; don't fork the seam.
- One push per review round; no pushes after the PR is out for verdicts unless a verdict asks.
